summary: The LLM landscape today is dominated by a few frontier vendors—OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google—whose models reach enterprises not only through direct APIs but also via cloud aggregators like AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Snowflake Cortex, and IBM watsonx, which substantially amplify real-world adoption. Open-weight models from DeepSeek, Meta, Mistral, and Alibaba continue to gain strong developer traction due to dramatically lower costs and HuggingFace availability. Because much of the live research data references unverifiable or speculatively-named future models, this ranking is restricted to models whose names and availability can be confirmed with confidence.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.popularity_notes: Remains the most widely called general-purpose model across direct OpenAI API and Azure OpenAI Service, giving it enormous enterprise aggregator reach.
models.best_for: General-purpose multimodal applications and production chat assistants

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.popularity_notes: Research notes it matches Opus-level performance at Sonnet pricing, and it is available via AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Azure, driving heavy enterprise coding adoption.
models.best_for: Enterprise coding assistants and agentic automation

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: The 'context window king' per research, distributed natively through Google Vertex AI and the Gemini API, giving it strong enterprise reach.
models.best_for: Long-context document analysis and multimodal reasoning

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.popularity_notes: Low-cost, fast Claude tier widely used for high-volume production tasks and available across Bedrock and Vertex AI aggregators.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.popularity_notes: Cost-efficient high-throughput Gemini variant with 1M context, heavily adopted via Vertex AI for scalable enterprise pipelines.
models.best_for: High-scale, cost-sensitive applications needing large context

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models.popularity_notes: Cited as the cheapest frontier-class reasoning model at $0.55/$2.19 per 1M tokens, with massive HuggingFace download volume as an open-weight MoE model.
models.best_for: Mathematical and algorithmic reasoning at low cost

models.name: DeepSeek V3
models.popularity_notes: Widely downloaded open-weight general model offering near-frontier performance at a fraction of proprietary costs, popular for self-hosted deployments.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.popularity_notes: One of the most downloaded open-weight models on HuggingFace and available through AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Vertex AI, giving it broad enterprise and developer reach.

models.name: o3
models.popularity_notes: OpenAI's dedicated reasoning model used for complex multi-step tasks, available through the OpenAI API and Azure OpenAI for enterprise reasoning workloads.
models.best_for: Complex reasoning, research, and advanced problem-solving

models.name: Mistral Large 2
models.popularity_notes: Leading European frontier model available via Azure, AWS Bedrock, and Vertex AI, favored by EU enterprises for data-sovereignty-conscious deployments.

models.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B
models.popularity_notes: Highly downloaded open-weight MoE model on HuggingFace with growing global developer adoption and availability via Alibaba Cloud.
